name: No events returned
explanation: With an empty event window, all configured approaches are unobserved. Verify logging and the observation window before choosing removal.

name: Remove missing protected; keep permissive
explanation: Remove protected phase 1 while retaining permissive phase 2, pedestrian phase 3, and detector 118.

name: Remove missing permissive overlap; keep protected
explanation: Clear only permissive overlap 2 and its flag. Preserve protected phase 1 and all detectors.

name: Remove missing pedestrian overlap; keep vehicle phases
explanation: Clear only pedestrian overlap 3. Do not remove vehicle phases or detector 118.

name: Remove multiple assignments; keep remaining phase
explanation: Remove protected phase 1 and permissive overlap 2 together, retaining pedestrian phase 3 and detector 118.

name: Remove last assignment; keep approach and detectors
explanation: Removing the last assignment leaves an unassigned approach with its detector. Deleting the whole approach is a separate action.

name: Delete entire unobserved approach explicitly
explanation: No assignments were observed. Clearing them preserves the approach; the separate whole-approach delete removes its detectors too.
